dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will we meet again at the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Oh? You'd like to enroll at the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Good, good! I can see that you are a true lover of knowledge, intelligent and agile in your thoughts. You certainly have the talent for it! *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: You can even use the elements to boot, and are brimming with experience adventuring outdoors. Indeed, I'd say that you'd be a perfect fit for the Spantamad, which primarily studies the elements and the ley lines.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: By the way, I'm a member of the Spantamad myself.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Given your skills, of the Six Darshans... I would deem the Haravatat my least recommended option.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: The Haravatat spends much time with ancient runes, and its members are as eccentric in speech as they are few in number. I don't think there's much to look forward to there...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: So when it comes to picking your own personal research path, I'd recommend the Spantamad over the Haravatat.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *cough* Well, that's assuming that you do manage to enroll in the Akademiya, of course.
